# Screening and Room Rules
Fenwray Film Society is a fictional organisation.

Adopted: 20 February 2025
Effective: 1 March 2025

## 1. Screening schedule
1.1 The society normally holds two public screenings each month.
1.2 The committee confirms dates at least 21 days beforehand.
1.3 Screenings take place in a room hired by the society.
1.4 The society does not own or permanently control the room.
1.5 The secretary maintains the official screening calendar.

## 2. Reservations
2.1 Reservations open 14 calendar days before each screening.
2.2 Reservations close two hours before the advertised start time.
2.3 Each person may reserve no more than four tickets per screening.
2.4 Reservations are confirmed only when full payment is received.
2.5 Ticket prices are set by film-fees.md.
2.6 Unpaid requests do not reserve seats.

## 3. Capacity and entry
3.1 The maximum audience is 42 people, excluding duty volunteers.
3.2 At least two duty volunteers must attend every public screening.
3.3 Doors open 30 minutes before the advertised start time.
3.4 Reserved seats are held until 10 minutes after the advertised start.
3.5 Late arrivals may enter only during a suitable break.
3.6 Entry is refused once the permitted audience capacity is reached.

## 4. Cancellations and changes
4.1 The coordinator may cancel a screening for safety or room unavailability.
4.2 A changed film title must be announced before doors open.
4.3 Ticket refunds are determined by film-refunds.md.
4.4 The coordinator records the reason for any cancellation.

## 5. Room and audience safety
5.1 Exit routes must be checked before the audience enters.
5.2 The room must be cleared within 30 minutes after the screening ends.
5.3 Equipment must be placed so cables do not obstruct walking routes.
5.4 The duty volunteers apply the safety rules in film-safety.md.
5.5 Audience conduct is governed by film-conduct.md.

6	# Refunds and Uncovered Matters
7	Fenwray Film Society is a fictional organisation.
8	
9	Adopted: 25 March 2025
10	Effective: 1 April 2025
11	
12	## 1. Member ticket cancellations
13	1.1 A ticket holder may request cancellation in writing.
14	1.2 Requests received at least 48 hours before the screening receive a full refund.
15	1.3 Requests received later receive no refund.
16	1.4 The receipt time recorded by the secretary decides which rule applies.
17	1.5 Refunds are made within 10 working days of approval.
18	
19	## 2. Society screening cancellations
20	2.1 If the society cancels a screening, every paid ticket receives a full refund.
21	2.2 If the advertised film changes, buyers may request a full refund before entry.
22	2.3 A buyer who enters after being informed of the change loses that option.
23	2.4 No additional travel or accommodation expenses are reimbursed.
24	
25	## 3. Equipment booking cancellations
26	3.1 A borrower may cancel by writing to the equipment officer.
27	3.2 Cancellation at least seven calendar days before collection receives a full hire-fee refund.
28	3.3 Cancellation later than that receives 50% of the hire fee.
29	3.4 The cancellation receipt date determines the applicable refund.
30	3.5 Security deposits are returned in full when collection never occurred.
31	3.6 Damage and late-return deductions follow film-equipment.md.
32	
33	## 4. Refund administration
34	4.1 Refunds are issued by bank transfer unless cash repayment is agreed.
35	4.2 Refund requests must identify the booking or ticket concerned.
36	4.3 The treasurer keeps a record of the amount, reason and payment date.
37	4.4 Membership fee refunds are governed by film-fees.md.
38	
39	## 5. Matters not covered
40	5.1 These rules do not establish a hardship or emergency-membership scheme.
41	5.2 They do not set compensation for lost personal property.
42	5.3 They do not specify film selection or programming criteria.
43	5.4 The committee considers these matters individually if they arise.
44	5.5 Individual decisions do not automatically create a continuing policy.
